pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/62192

This PR makes several improvements to multi-node editing. The general idea here is to remove all visible references to MultiNodeEdit so that multi-node editing is done behind-the-scenes.

- Show the revert button for properties that are not default for all selected nodes
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67974470/174666998-95de685d-fc68-48f0-b1e1-214cecf2e2d9.png)
- Hide metadata on MultiNodeEdit and AnimationMultiTrackKeyEdit
- Show documentation in property tooltips.
- When all selected nodes have a property that is not from the same class, it's treated the same way it was before this PR with no documentation tooltips or revert button. This is because documentation and default values can be different between the different classes.
e.g. if you select a Control and a Node2D, both have `rotation` and `scale` even though CanvasItem doesn't.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67974470/174666451-2d58adb3-6584-457b-9f7e-02dc6e803ea2.png)
- Hide the "MultiNodeEdit" category header
	- I had to hardcode this into EditorInspector because it appears that `_validate_property()`, which is used to dynamically hide properties, doesn't run for categories (`PROPERTY_HINT_CATEGORY`). I tried to enable this but I looked all over and couldn't figure out how to. I'm still not a C++ wizard yet :(
- MultiNodeEdit: Show the most common class name and icon and the number of selected nodes at the top of the inspector.
The "most common" class is determined by finding the highest level class that all of the selected nodes have in common.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67974470/174666692-26279f28-c1d8-4862-a166-0198e573add1.png)
pr_comments: Ok, it should be ready for review now! I've fixed several bugs and updated the OP with a better description and screenshots.

Groupless properties looks a bit weird:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/178998307-d9fe5156-2075-4d12-b20b-a7b679f0c1d9.png)
Maybe there should be "Common Properties" group?

This still appears (from MultiNodeEdit):
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/178998495-23c2af59-b8e6-4a71-95a0-90f934d2f76a.png)
Ok, I'll rebase and make the changes needed soon.

issue_context.title: Resources that should hide metadata editing in the inspector don't
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4366f8b

### System information

N/A

### Issue description

Resources like `Animation(Multi)TrackKeyEdit` and `MultiNodeEdit` should have their metadata editing hidden (as editing them is pointless), but they don't.

### Steps to reproduce

Select multiple nodes or multiple tracks in an animation.

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_

review_comments: The RefCounted problem might be solved by adding a `||` for `p.name` here.

The other categories should still show for MultiNodeEdit though. The only categories that need to be hidden are MultiNodeEdit and RefCounted.

A better way to fix that would be to call `_validate_property()` for properties with `PROPERTY_HINT_CATEGORY`, but I couldn't figure out how to do that.
We don't allow using assignments in `if` conditions.
